newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Canada's Repap drops.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Canada's Repap drops.

text.p: Canadian forest products company Repap Enterprises Inc tumbled Monday after it reported a second-quarter loss and said it would issue shares to pay off part of its debt.
Repap was off 3/32 to 1/8 on the Nasdaq exchange in heavy trade. Repap headed the most-active list for foreign shares and American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
The company reported a loss of C$0.39 a share for the second quarter, compared with a loss of C$0.35 a year earlier.
Repap said it would write off C$30.3 million in discontinued operations and issue 625 million common shares to pay off US$130 million due Friday.

Canadian waste treatment company Thermo Tech Technologies Inc rose 11/32 to 3-7/32 in heavy trade. At mid-morning, the shares were among the most active on the Nasdaq and volume was more than four times normal daily levels.

The company said its patented technology had been selected as the recommended technology by the Institute for Local Self Reliance. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency contracted the group to study waste-handling methods.

Among Latin American ADRs, Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA rose 5-11/16 to 149-9/16. Telebras had fallen more than 40 points from a record high 169-1/4 on July 10, shaken by jitters over Brazil's currency.

"I think that now that calm has been restored, people are starting to step in for Telebras's value," said Curtis Butler, vice president in the emerging markets group at Lazard Freres & Co. "You're getting some people taking advantage of the dip."
Argentina's Banco de Galicia fell 3/8 to 30-5/8 after UBS Securities cut its rating on the bank to hold from buy.

Venezuelan paint company Corimon SACA rocketed up 9-11/16 to 10-9/16 as its ADRs resumed trade after being suspended in early 1996. The company's stock was restructured last week, with each ADR equivalent to 250 ordinary shares, up from 35 shares when trading was suspended.
In other active shares, Gulf Canada Resources Ltd fell 10/16 to 7-3/16 after it announced it would buy Stampeder Exploration Ltd in a stock swap worth C$1 billion.
Decliners led gainers 269 to 197 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group was down 0.02 percent, and volume was 28 million ADRs.
